headline: Sensex and Nifty extend winning streak for fifth day as global cues cheer markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty extended gains for a fifth straight day, with Sensex reclaiming its 200-DMA.
US midterm election results lowered the US dollar and cheered global market sentiment.
Crude oil prices declined for a fourth consecutive day on lower risk expectations of Iran war escalation.
Gold prices rose following its biggest daily gain since August amidst global market movements.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets defied mixed Asian cues to maintain momentum ahead of Samvat 2083.
Analysts are optimistic about Sensex and Nifty scaling new record highs in the upcoming Samvat.
Zydus Lifesciences reported a 26.6% drop in consolidated Q2 net profit to Rs 925.5 crore.
Eight stocks experienced positive technical breakouts by crossing above their 200 DMAs.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty extended their rally for the fifth consecutive session, driven by positive global cues following US midterm election outcomes. Lower oil prices and strong technical momentum provided additional support to domestic sentiment. Meanwhile, corporate earnings saw Zydus Lifesciences report a 26.6% decline in Q2 net profit.
